procedure: Pages rendered with pdfplumber page.to_image(resolution=220); the five pages are LANDSCAPE-GENUINE (raw ~2420x1870 renders read upright directly, no transpose -- cache/2026-scan-assessment/tier1/coahoma/). Every in-scope row's cross-page cell sum equals its printed TOTAL exactly (12/12).
structure_note: Same two-table shape as the other Tier-1 five-page sheets: p1 is the certification/signature page; p2+p3 = table A over the county's 18 precincts (11 columns, then Friars Point/Jonestown/Lula/Lyon/Rena Lara/Roundaway/Sasse Street Fire Station + TOTAL) carrying the state-office sections; p4+p5 = table B (same column split) carrying the continuation rows and locals. The SEMS row-block split cut the Circuit Court 11-2 section between its two candidates: Morris-Harris's row completes table A and David L. Tisdell's row starts p4 ahead of the local zone (the Adams-Hampton pattern); the 'Circuit Court 11-3-Circuit District 11-3' header prints below Tisdell's row p4 with Charles E. Webster's row under it. Races: U.S. Senate; US House Of Rep 02-2nd Congressional District; Court Of Appeals 02-District 2 Position 1 (Deborah A. McDonald, sole candidate); Chancery Court 7-1-Chancery District 7-1 Place 1 (Catherine Farris-Carter -- the same section Quitman prints, roster identical); Circuit Court 11-1-Circuit District 11-1 (W. Hunter Nowell); Circuit Court 11-2-Circuit District 11-2 (Stephanie 'Nikki' Morris-Harris, David L. Tisdell -- Quitman's 11-2 roster); Circuit Court 11-3-Circuit District 11-3 (Charles E. Webster -- Quitman's 11-3 candidate). Printed totals: Colom 4835, Hyde-Smith 1288, Pinkins 53, Eller 1244, G. Thompson 4808, Foster 115, McDonald 4359, Farris-Carter 4490, Nowell 777, Morris-Harris 1108, Tisdell 601, Webster 2379.
operator_rows_note: All 12 in-scope rows supplied by operator_rows in ballot order; table-A rows carry p2 (eleven precinct cells) + p3 (seven precinct cells + printed TOTAL); Tisdell's and Webster's rows carry p4 + p5 cells + the p5 printed TOTAL. The X-celled rows (Nowell, Morris-Harris, Tisdell, Webster) supply only the numeric cells plus the printed TOTAL: the X-marked blanks become 0 under the row's own printed TOTAL (Nowell 777 = 57+612+16+21+71; Morris-Harris 1108 = 12+20+174+533+44+47+25+253; Tisdell 601 = 17+22+120+246+38+35+20+103; Webster 2379 = 308+79+663+95+81+201+235+144+573), the established X-cell rule both pages over.
truncation_note: No truncations; the eighteen precinct headers print complete (Bobo, Cagle Crossing, Clarksdale Courthouse, Clarksdale #2, Clarksdale #3, Clarksdale #4, Clarksdale #4 North, Clarksdale #5, Coahoma, Dublin, Farrell, Friars Point, Jonestown, Lula, Lyon, Rena Lara, Roundaway, Sasse Street Fire Station).
local_note: p4/p5 carry the local sections after Circuit 11-3: Coahoma-Coahoma County Attorney (Christopher Michael Finn), Coahoma-Coahoma County Judge (A. Burks Rogers), Yazoo-Mississippi Delta Levee District-Yazoo Mississippi Delta Levee Commissioner (Birley (B.C.) Gipson, Jr.), School District 5-School District 5 (Johnnie Moore) -- all local, out of scope, contributing no parse rows on operator-supply pages. Circuit 11's Places 1/2/3 all print in-county, so the family writes the Place-qualified labels 'Circuit Court Place 1/2/3' (matching Quitman's Place 2/Place 3 rows).
